input.plan:
# Epic 2 Implementation Plan

## Goal
Deliver Tickets 2.1–2.3 by introducing an AI service layer (`GeminiService`, `Gatekeeper`, `FactExtractor`) and new ingestors (`PdfIngestor`, `EmlIngestor`) that emit `BuildingFact[]` with traceability and `temperature: 0`.

## Current Baseline Confirmed
- Core contracts are already in place in [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/types.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/types.ts).
- Existing ingestors and tests establish conventions:
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/JsonIngestor.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/JsonIngestor.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/CsvIngestor.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/CsvIngestor.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/__tests__/JsonIngestor.test.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/__tests__/JsonIngestor.test.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/__tests__/CsvIngestor.test.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/__tests__/CsvIngestor.test.ts)
- Incremental simulation has rich EML signals and invoice metadata CSVs in `day-*`; this supports Epic 2 immediately.

## Target Design
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  rawDocument[RawDocument_EML_or_PDFText] --> gatekeeper[Gatekeeper_isRelevant]
  gatekeeper -->|"relevant=true"| extractor[FactExtractor_extractFacts]
  gatekeeper -->|"relevant=false"| noFacts[ReturnEmptyFacts]
  extractor --> mapper[MapToBuildingFact]
  mapper --> ingestor[EmlIngestor_or_PdfIngestor]
  ingestor --> output[BuildingFactArray]
```

## File Plan
- Add AI service wrapper and domain services:
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/GeminiService.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/GeminiService.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/Gatekeeper.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/Gatekeeper.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/FactExtractor.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/FactExtractor.ts)
- Add tests first for each new service:
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/__tests__/GeminiService.test.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/__tests__/GeminiService.test.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/__tests__/Gatekeeper.test.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/__tests__/Gatekeeper.test.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/__tests__/FactExtractor.test.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/services/__tests__/FactExtractor.test.ts)
- Add ingestors + tests:
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/PdfIngestor.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/PdfIngestor.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/EmlIngestor.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/EmlIngestor.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/__tests__/PdfIngestor.test.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/__tests__/PdfIngestor.test.ts)
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/__tests__/EmlIngestor.test.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/ingestors/__tests__/EmlIngestor.test.ts)
- Optional type additions to keep dependencies abstract:
  - [`/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/types.ts`](/Users/gerograms/workspace/hackathon/src/engine/types.ts)

## Ticket-by-Ticket TDD Sequence

### Ticket 2.1: GeminiService + Gatekeeper
1. Write failing tests for `GeminiService` covering:
   - constructor/API key handling from env
   - request payload enforces `temperature: 0`
   - deterministic return parsing and error propagation
2. Implement minimal `GeminiService` to satisfy tests.
3. Write failing tests for `Gatekeeper` covering:
   - relevant maintenance/legal/financial docs -> `true`
   - irrelevant/general noise -> `false`
   - malformed model output -> safe fallback (`false`)
4. Implement `Gatekeeper` with strict JSON response contract and defensive parsing.

### Ticket 2.2: FactExtractor
1. Write failing tests for `FactExtractor` covering:
   - JSON extraction to normalized shape (`category`, `key`, `value`, `confidenceScore`)
   - category constrained to `core_erp | financial | maintenance | governance`
   - source traceability fields are attached by caller/mapper
   - invalid model JSON returns empty facts or explicit controlled error (single chosen behavior)
2. Implement extractor prompt + parser in small pure functions (parse/validate/map split).
3. Ensure all generation/extraction calls run with `temperature: 0` through `GeminiService`.

### Ticket 2.3: PdfIngestor + EmlIngestor
1. Write failing ingestor tests for:
   - gatekeeper false -> empty array
   - gatekeeper true + extractor facts -> mapped `BuildingFact[]`
   - `isGoldStandard` always `false` for AI-derived facts
   - `source.fileType` is `pdf`/`eml`, `source.fileId` preserved
2. Implement `EmlIngestor` using file-read text path and services composition.
3. Implement `PdfIngestor` using text input strategy consistent with current fixtures (index/metadata-first approach until physical PDFs are introduced).
4. Add/extend integration coverage to prove AI ingestor facts can be persisted to `sources` + `facts` schema similar to existing ERP integration style.

## Acceptance Criteria
- New service and ingestor tests pass under `vitest`.
- All AI calls are enforced at `temperature: 0`.
- `BuildingFact` outputs from EML/PDF flow include traceable `source` references and `isGoldStandard: false`.
- Existing Epic 1 tests remain green.
- No schema changes required for Epic 2 unless extraction needs additional source metadata.

## Risks and Guardrails
- LLM output instability: mitigate with strict JSON schema validation and safe fallback behavior.
- Over-coupling ingestors to Gemini SDK: keep a small `GeminiService` interface boundary.
- PDF fixture gap in day folders: start with metadata/text-first ingestion path and keep parser swappable for real PDF extraction later.
